testability.QSPI_via_note: All12targeted QSPl/CS vias are tented on both faces; do not treat them as exposed testpads.
testability.low_frequency_log_marker_option: Existing LED pad can be repurposed in diagnostic firmware subject to Raytac slow/standard-drive restriction; not a high-speed trace/GPIO header.
fixture_power_cut_policy: Use current-limited battery emulator at J2 pin1VBAT/pin3GND, an appropriate simulated NTC on pin2, and an external controlled cut/sag switch. Monitor actual TP2/+3V0 and local U5VCC.
USB VBUS must be absent or independently switched for a real loss-of-power test; battery removal alone whileUSB is present need not remove SYS power.

Debugger target-power output off. J3pin1 is VTref sense only. Disconnect/isolate SWD and reset drive during a power cut so IO cannot sustain the rail; do not assume a debugger releases outputs when target unpowered.
Logic analyzer/oscilloscope/trigger connections must not source the unpowered DUT. Verify measured rail decay and absence of backpower from every instrument/data path.

Do not force voltage directly onto TP2/+3V0 while the connected LDO/other rails can be backfed. A forced Flash-only sag requires an explicitly engineered isolation/rework fixture, not an assumed present PCB feature.

Keep bottom SWD/TP pads physically accessible before mounting the battery or housing. Whole-device fault injection requires no PCB redesign; no dedicated automatic fault-injection hardware is on-board.

coverage.hardware_access: SWD J3, +3V0 TP2, GND TP4; diagnostic firmware reads IDs/statuses.

Custom-command firmware plus CS atR10.2, clock atR11.2 and IO0/IO1 atU5 pads; microprobes/temporary fine wires required for capture. Small WSON toes may require controlled local mask rework/interposer on one measurement prototype; ordinary clip access is not guaranteed.
Flash array via existing QSPI and host-side CRC through SWD/USB/BLE diagnostic transport.
Same QSPI physical path; full-address test software, no bank-select hardware needed.
Page-boundary diagnostic firmware and independent host image.
Aligned/bounce-buffer software and DMA diagnostics; microprobe capture optional.
Driver API bounds tests; verify no bus command with digital capture when needed.
B7/custom commands and both-die SR; clock/CS/IO capture asF02.
Both-die status logging through QSPI; exact C2/WEL semantics remain vendor/driver work.
Erase diagnostics on existing memory plus CRC/sentinels.
Both-die chip erase/polling with adequately long host/driver timeout.
Both-die global-operation logging/capture; hardware does not force deterministic die timing divergence. Synthetic status injection supplements, never replaces physical evidence.
MCU-only reset viaJ3.5/TP5 while +3V0 remains present; nRESET UICR configuration and open-drain fixture required.
Flash software66/99 reset through QSPI; no dedicated Flash RESET pin or reset button exists.
Firmware B9/AB and independent MCU reset throughJ3.5/TP5.
External programmable battery-source/cut fixture atJ2 PACK+,monitorTP3/TP2 and localU5VCC; remove all unintended power sources.
Same external power-cut fixture, trigger from CS/log marker, instrument real voltage/time and recover journal.
Diagnostic full-memory/timeout/transfer tests viaSWD/USB/BLE; no automatic functioning USB fallback assumed.
Existing BLE/IMU plus IRQTP6/TP7 and firmware counters; use SWD logging with its electrical influence recorded.

External temperature/supply fixture and low-capacitance local QSPI probes; no dedicated QSPI headers. Timing not qualified by this audit. Small WSON toes may require controlled local mask rework/interposer on one measurement prototype; ordinary clip access is not guaranteed.

testability.QSPI_probe_caveat: IO0/IO1 WSON toes are not guaranteed accessible to ordinary clips. A sacrificial measurement unit may require controlled solder-mask opening/microsoldering or an interposer; check shorts and probe loading afterward. No such rework has been performed.

A_before_PCBA_order.item: Import all33groups/59refs into Standard PCBA and confirm exactMPN/C matches, real quantities/lead times/attrition; resolve U7/R1/R20 through confirmed JLC procurement, preorder/global sourcing/consignment if needed.

Complete visual/numerical current-lot footprint drawing acceptance for J1 short slots/NPTH/edge datum, Y1 land pattern, and Raytac61pad P1MV2 drawing; this audit does not invent unavailable image evidence.
JLC acceptance of exact stencil/mask/EP soldering, drill/slot tolerances, nominal0.150mm hole-to-SMD/paste margin, and panel/fiducials; confirm IMU+Raytac Xray and moisture/reflow handling.
Approve all59matched placements, pin1/polarity, J2orientation and actual tape conventions in JLC preview; KiCad rotation alone is not assembly approval.

Close electrical/static-safety and chosen fabrication stackup/process conditions from the independent power/Raytac/DFM reviews before order. Physical Flash functionality, SI/EMC and charge-cycle qualification belong to GateB.

B_after_prototypes: Implement/pin Flash driver and resolve AN0000035 semantics; run F01-F20, all currently NOT_RUN.
Measure QSPI/SPI/USB timing, full128MiB CRC, warm/cold reset, DPD, both-die erase and power-cut journal recovery.
Measure all-port USB current/inrush/suspend, rails/Ceff effects, load/thermal behavior, IMU noise/bias/FIFO and BLE/RF/synchronization.
Qualify a protected real-cell pack/PCM/on-cellNTC/harness and safe charge behavior before charging/wearing it. Missing pack MPN does not make the separately assembled PCB unassemblable.
C_optional_future_optimization: Dedicated low-stub QSPI probe pads or a debug interposer for easier repeated probing.
Optional controllable Flash supply/isolation if isolated peripheral power faults become a research requirement; not needed for current whole-device power-cut tests.
Further routing/energy/fixture convenience improvements only after measured evidence; retained128MiB architecture and current routing remain unchanged.
